# scm_dlp_dry_run_scan (Action)

> **Beta / Experimental:** Enterprise DLP support (`scm_dlp_*`) in `terraform-provider-scm` is currently in **Beta / Experimental** and subject to schema or behavior changes.

[Beta / Experimental] Runs one or more Enterprise DLP dry-run scans (positive and negative test cases) against a data profile using multipart form-data.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# [Beta / Experimental] Invoke a positive and negative dry-run test suite against a data profile.
#
# Usage:
#   terraform apply -invoke=action.scm_dlp_dry_run_scan.check

action "scm_dlp_dry_run_scan" "check" {
  config {
    data_profile_id  = scm_dlp_data_profile.employee_pii.id
    fail_on_mismatch = true

    test_cases = [
      {
        name             = "positive-sample-file"
        file_path        = "${path.module}/testdata/positive/sample_sensitive.txt"
        expected_verdict = "MATCHED"
        expected_action  = "block"
      },
      {
        name             = "negative-benign-file"
        file_path        = "${path.module}/testdata/negative/sample_benign.txt"
        expected_verdict = "NOT_MATCHED"
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `data_profile` (String) JSON string representing the data profile configuration to test. Either data_profile or data_profile_id must be provided.
- `data_profile_id` (String) ID of an existing Enterprise DLP data profile (e.g. scm_dlp_data_profile.<name>.id) to fetch and test. Either data_profile or data_profile_id must be provided.
- `dry_run_service_name` (String) Optional dry-run service name (defaults to prisma-access).
- `expected_action` (String) Optional expected action for single-file scan (e.g. 'block', 'alert', 'allow').
- `expected_verdict` (String) Optional expected verdict for single-file scan (e.g. 'MATCHED' for positive tests or 'NOT_MATCHED' for negative tests).
- `fail_on_mismatch` (Boolean) Whether to fail the Terraform operation with an error diagnostic if any expected_verdict or expected_action does not match the scan result (defaults to true).
- `file_content` (String) Raw content of a single file to scan. Used when test_cases is not specified.
- `file_name` (String) Name of the file being scanned (defaults to 'sample.txt' if file_content is used).
- `file_path` (String) Path to a single file to upload and scan. Used when test_cases is not specified.
- `file_sha` (String) SHA256 hex string of the file (computed automatically if omitted).
- `source_data_profile_id` (String) Optional source data profile ID.
- `test_cases` (Attributes List) Optional list of positive and negative test cases (files or inline content) to scan against the data profile. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--test_cases))

<a id="nestedatt--test_cases"></a>
### Nested Schema for `test_cases`

Optional:

- `expected_action` (String) Optional expected scan action (e.g. 'block', 'alert').
- `expected_verdict` (String) Expected scan verdict: 'MATCHED' for positive test cases or 'NOT_MATCHED' for negative test cases.
- `file_content` (String) Inline content to scan for this test case.
- `file_name` (String) File name sent in the multipart upload (defaults to basename of file_path or 'sample.txt').
- `file_path` (String) Path to the local file to upload and scan for this test case.
- `file_sha` (String) Optional SHA256 hex digest of the file.
- `name` (String) Descriptive name for this test case (e.g. 'positive-pci-csv' or 'negative-benign-readme').
